abilities.name: Fire of the Forge
abilities.description: Hurls fire at a structure. Costs divinity equal to the power; a strike at or above the ignition threshold sets a combustible target alight.

abilities.name: Craftsman's Tale
abilities.description: Tells of a made thing or a debt of craft, told aloud to everyone present and recorded as a legend.

abilities.name: Gift of Craft
abilities.description: Answers a mortal's prayer for help with what it needs.

relationships.note: In one telling she bore him alone and cast him out; in another Thetis took him in. The starting value is authored tuning.
In the Iliad Zeus hurled him from the threshold of heaven after he took Hera's part. The starting value is authored tuning.
They teach crafts to men together. The starting value is authored tuning.

lore.statement: At Thetis's asking Hephaestus forges Achilles' armour and shield in his house.
With bright-eyed Athena he taught glorious crafts to men on earth, who once lived in caves.
Hephaestus says Zeus caught him by the foot and hurled him from the threshold of heaven after he took Hera's side; he fell all day and landed on Lemnos.
Hephaestus says his mother wished to hide him for his lameness and threw him out, and Thetis and Eurynome took him in.
Hera bore Hephaestus without union with Zeus, in anger at Zeus's bearing Athena.

variants.note: In Iliad 1 Zeus hurls Hephaestus from heaven for helping Hera. In Iliad 18 his mother throws him out for his lameness. The profile keeps both and leaves unsaid whether they are one fall.

inventions.statement: Hephaestus's domain troubles are the game's own.
inventions.reason: A forge flare that damages the forge, and cracked tools that spoil smithwork, are troubles the game draws on a season's odds and a floor, damaging the forge or taking goods. The sources attest his forge and craft; no source tells these episodes.

inventions.statement: His fire is a damaging strike on structures.
inventions.reason: The world has no craft or fire action but strike; it is the one place his fire can show. A game stand-in.

inventions.statement: His tales of made things are told in play as legends.
inventions.reason: Legend is the world's only public telling; it is a game mapping.

inventions.statement: His gifts to those who pray are the world's bless action.
inventions.reason: The world's one way to help a mortal is to bless it.

inventions.statement: The forge by the town square and the smiths who revere him are placed by the game.
inventions.reason: The sources give him a forge on Olympus and at Lemnos but no town smithy. The forge and its smiths are an invention.

inventions.statement: The drive weights and the starting dispositions of Hephaestus are authored tuning.
inventions.reason: The sources describe temperament in prose; the numbers are a design choice to be revised against play.

troubles.statement: A forge flares: the forge is damaged. Summer.
Tools crack and smithwork is spoiled: tools or ore are lost. Autumn and winter.
